instruction: A cinematic video still, medium shot, showing three people dancing in an indoor studio with a plain backdrop. On the left, the blonde woman in the black halter dress (R3) laughs with her head tilted back, dancing dynamically. In the center background, the Black woman in the red fringed dress (R1) smiles and looks to her right. On the right, the man in the denim jacket (R4) smiles and looks down-left while dancing. The three dance together in a loose group, with the blonde woman (R3) and the man (R4) facing slightly toward each other. Soft pink and purple studio lighting casts a warm, vibrant glow over the scene.
